  src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql - Initial schema: tables for shipments, vehicles, playlists and reviews.
  src/test/java/com/acme/app/playlist/PlaylistControllerTest.java - MockMvc tests for /playlists.

  src/test/java/com/acme/app/review/ReviewServiceTest.java - JUnit 5 unit tests for ReviewService.

The mobile app needs `helpful_votes` (helpful votes) on every review from the API. Backend change only; do not touch the web UI. This is blocking the next release.
